title: Saudi Arabia Faces the Era of Disequilibrium
gist: CSIS argues the ongoing, escalating Iran war has exposed Saudi Arabia's two core risks: regional conflict undermining its safe-investment reputation and volatile, disruptable oil exports (Hormuz, Bab al-Mandab, Eastern Province infrastructure). Riyadh will prioritize de-escalation, alternative export pipelines and renewables/nuclear, diversified defense partnerships (Mecca Joint Defense Agreement) and a narrowed Vision 2030 that shelves NEOM giga-projects like The Line and Trojena.
